Definition: to quaff to satiety, i.e. become tipsy
BiblicalUsage: çâbâʼ is simply to quaff to satiety, to become tipsy. Scripture uses it in Ezekiel, and the context leaves nothing to guess at.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that çâbâʼ is no exception: no word in Scripture is filler.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
